name: fiji_module_search
description: Find SciJava commands and scripts whose title, menu path, description or class contain all the words of the query. Every Fiji command and plugin is a module: search here before writing code.

query.description: words that must all appear, e.g. 'gaussian blur'

name: fiji_module_describe
description: Describe a module's inputs and outputs (types, labels, descriptions, defaults and choices after its initializers ran), the live objects that can fill its object inputs, and the artifact that provides it (provided_by: groupId:artifactId:version). id: a class name, menu path, title, or script file path.

id.description: command title, menu path, class name, or script file path

name: fiji_module_run
description: Run a module (command class, menu path, title, or the path of a script file) with inputs as a JSON object, e.g. {"sigma": 2, "image": "blobs.gif"}. Never opens the module's dialog: inputs not given keep their default; an object input with one live instance is bound to it, else pass its name (see fiji_objects). Returns status, outputs (objects by name, pictures as images), new objects, the modules it ran in turn (nested), and the warnings and errors it logged (messages). status is error when the module threw or reported success = false (error says why), canceled, or ok; ok with logged_errors (their number) and first_error means it ended normally but logged errors: check its outputs. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 30, at most 40: clients abort requests after about 60 s; follow a longer run with fiji_module_status). A run still going returns its job id, status running, and the titles of the modal dialogs open (dialogs); blocked_by_dialog means the job itself waits for a dialog.

id.description: command title, menu path, class name, or script file path

inputs.description: JSON object of input values by name, e.g. {"sigma": 2}; inputs not given keep their default

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait for the result before returning the job id (default 30, at most 40: clients abort requests after about 60 s; follow a longer run with fiji_module_status)

name: fiji_module_run_script
description: Run a script given as text (Groovy by default) as fiji_module_run runs a script file: same inputs, result, job id and status, nothing written to disk. For what no command does: search the commands first. Declare what it needs with #@ lines, e.g. '#@ ImagePlus image' (an object input with one live instance is bound to it) or '#@ CommandService command', and what it returns with '#@output String result'. Recorded in fiji_module_script with its code; '#@script(record="false")' leaves out a script that only looks.

language.description: groovy (default, recommended), or another language name or file extension; 'python' is Jython 2.7, not CPython: no numpy, no pip packages

inputs.description: JSON object of input values by name, as for fiji_module_run

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait for the result before returning the job id (default 30, at most 40: clients abort requests after about 60 s; follow a longer run with fiji_module_status)

name: fiji_module_status
description: Follow a run started by fiji_module_run: waits up to wait_seconds and returns its result as fiji_module_run does, or status running (or blocked_by_dialog) with the dialogs open. An empty job lists the runs - title, status (running, ok, error or canceled) and seconds each, the last 20 finished ones kept - and the modal dialogs open.

job.description: the job id returned by fiji_module_run; empty lists the runs

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait for the result before returning the job id (default 30, at most 40: clients abort requests after about 60 s; follow a longer run with fiji_module_status)

name: fiji_objects
description: The live objects Fiji holds (images, viewers, sessions...): without a type, the number of objects per type; with a type, the objects of that type by the names module inputs accept.

type.description: simple or full class name, e.g. ImagePlus; empty counts the objects per type

name: fiji_module_script
description: The successful fiji_module_run calls of this session as a Groovy script that replays them, every input explicit (modules declaring record=false, which only look, are left out). Once a result is right, save it (path) to keep the pipeline: edit it, turn values into #@ parameters, run it with fiji_module_run (its path is its id), or headless in a fresh Fiji.

path.description: file to write the script to; empty returns it

name: fiji_ui_windows_read
description: List visible AWT and Swing windows, including titles, classes, bounds, active state, and modality

name: fiji_ui_dialogs_read
description: List visible AWT and Swing dialogs, including each dialog's title, messages, buttons, and modal state

name: fiji_ui_dialog_respond
description: Click an exact enabled button in one visible dialog. This tool rejects missing or ambiguous dialogs and never chooses a button implicitly

button_text.description: Button text from the same dialog

name: fiji_ui_dialog_close
description: Request the normal window-manager close action for one visible dialog. This tool rejects missing or ambiguous dialogs, does not choose a button, and reports whether the dialog remains visible
